{{Quote|You ever run a job out to Zekulae, at the heart of the Zeemacht Cluster, lift your eyes from the comm for a minute. You'll be staring up at a matrix of bright orange and red giants, neutron stars, pulsars, and blue stragglers the Zeku call the Cosm's Well. It's about the most beautiful thing I've ever seen that I couldn't buy or sell, and that's saying something.|Crix Q5 Baobab|<ref name="TEA" />}}
'''Cosm's Well''' was the name for a [[Star cluster/Legends|globular cluster]] of [[Orange giant|orange]] and [[Red giant/Legends|red]] [[Giant star|giants]], [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]], [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsars]], and [[blue straggler]]s located beyond the [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht Cluster]] and visible from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zekulae]]. Like most globular clusters, it sat far above [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the stellar halo. [[Crix Q5 Baobab]] considered it to be extremely beautiful.<ref name="TEA" />
